body:
The -edit file contains `rdfs:label` annotation for several annotation properties (such as `oboInOwl:hasDbXref`, `IAO:0000115`, `oboInOwl:hasExactSynonym`, etc.) that already have a label defined in the `merged_import` module.
    
Not only are those labels useless (since redundant), but they are a frequent cause of spurious diffs, so they are better removed, which we do in this PR.

(As a side-effect, this PR also re-serializes the edit file, which is needed because a previous AI-generated change inserted a class at the wrong place, because of course LLMs don’t know that the axioms in a OFN file are conventionally _sorted_ – e.g., the axioms about a CL:7770002 class should appear _before_ the axioms about a CL:7770003 class.)

closes #3332
title: Dont relabel imported annotation properties
